# Data Downloads

To download data related to alternative fuels and advanced vehicles, follow the steps below.

* Required Fields

## Step 1. Choose data to download

Choose the dataset you want to download.

Dataset: * 

Timeframe: * 

Current – snapshot of data in the Station Locator today 

Past – historical data from the Station Locator starting in 2014 

Read descriptions of the [data included in the alternative fuel stations download](https://afdc.energy.gov/data_download/alt_fuel_stations_format).

Data updated on an ongoing basis. Learn more about the [station update schedule](https://afdc.energy.gov/stations/#/find/nearest?show_about=true).

_Just looking for the closest alternative fuel station?
